Slopographic

The type family of this site: a sans, a serif, a mono and a condensed face, made from open-source fonts and free to use, change and share under the SIL Open Font License.

Download the fonts (zip) Licence (OFL.txt) What changed (FONTLOG.txt)

Styles

Every style, its weights and its italic. Each family is a variable font where its source is one: any weight in the range works.

Stylistic sets and the drip ligature

Each line shows the default, then the set switched on (font-feature-settings). The drip ligature is discretionary: font-variant-ligatures: discretionary-ligatures.

Glyphs

The marks in the Private Use Area, then the Latin set, Swedish included.
